'''Podracer engines''' were a type of [[Engine/Legends|engine]] used by [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracers]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
Developing into the modern Podracer engine circa [[100 BBY/Legends|100 BBY]], these engines came in three varieties: [[Missile/Legends|rocket]] motors, turbine engines, and high-performance [[ion engine]]s. Salvaged, rebuilt, and scrapped, Podracer engines were converted from the wrecks of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], [[Turbofan/Legends|turbofans]], and [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]]. Hand-built and often custom jobs, it wasn't until closer to the time of the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that factory customs were designed and marketed as Podracer engines.<ref name="EV" />
